newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee market slow despite price falls.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee market slow despite price falls.

text.p: Arabica coffee prices in the Bremen physical market fell $2-9 per 50 kg fob on the week in line with futures reductions, traders said on Friday.
Trading was sluggish and restricted to replacement cover of Colombians, Brazils and East African arabicas.
Robustas saw little business because consumers were adequately covered.

Operators looked to the ACPC meetings scheduled for next week in London, where producer nations will seek to tighten supplies to stabilise prices. But major producers Vietnam, India and Papua New-Guinea are not members.
